data.narrative:
Swarmbotics AI is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Stephen Houghton and Drew Watson, having raised $17.2M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public peers in the defense automation and autonomous systems space, including same-stage companies like UFORCE ($1.0B) and adjacent-stage peers including Singularity ($400M) and NODA AI ($125M).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a valuation proxy, applies a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier to the $17.2M base, implying $43M. Peer-median analysis across the three nearest comparable transactions yields a $400M midpoint valuation, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. The substantial dispersion reflects heterogeneity in Defense & Security funding outcomes at this stage.

Reconciling both methods produces a triangulated range of $37M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $222M. The wide band reflects material uncertainty around Swarmbotics' relative positioning within its peer cohort—particularly whether the company's technology, commercial traction, and defensibility more closely align with later-stage, well-capitalized entrants like UFORCE or earlier-stage peers. Additional clarity on customer pipeline, technical differentiation, and capital efficiency would narrow this range materially.
